title: AWS Solutions Architect
summary: Thirty days from cloud fundamentals and the Well-Architected Framework through IAM, VPC design, compute, storage, databases, decoupling, serverless, containers, security, monitoring, disaster recovery, migration and cost optimisation, aligned with the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03) exam. Each day pairs exam-style quizzes and interview questions with hands-on Python simulations or architecture design exercises, ending in a full architecture-interview capstone.
